// NEGATIVE fixture — `.at(` only where a lexer must not see it.
// A line comment: list.at(-1)
/* A block comment: list.at(-1) */
const SINGLE = 'list.at(-1)';
const DOUBLE = "list.at(-1)";
const TEMPLATE = `index from length, never list.at(-1)`;
const IN_REGEX = /\.at\s*\(/;

export function mentionsAt(source) {
  return /\.at\s*\(/.test(source);
}

export function last(list) {
  // Near-miss in real code: `.attempts(` is not `.at(`.
  if (list.attempts && list.attempts()) return null;
  return list.length ? list[list.length - 1] : undefined;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
